dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline following a deep V-shaped notch mid-way on the trailing edge, transitioning to a smooth inward curve towards the peduncle base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel-radius rounded tip at the highest morphological vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin rising at an approximate 45-50 degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable V-shaped traumatic amputation on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; irregular dark epidermal lesion present on the lateral flank anterior to the fin midpoint; multiple white punctate scars and linear rake marks across the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive micro-mottling and white spotting across the visible dark-grey integument of the dorsal ridge and flank.
